name: Text To Speech Generator
description: Generate high-quality speech from text using local TTS models (Piper, Coqui XTTS v2, Kokoro-82M). Exposes a hook so other apps — like Sakura Slipstream — can request audio generation from within their workflows.
author: TrulyStupid
